name: Love-Enmity Station
source:
Rudy is a student who graduated from his university. He should be able to enjoy his dream job without the slightest obstacle. However, his parents and neighbors have begun to force Rudy to get married. Rudy, who was already resigned to finding a partner, began looking for girlfriend through application. However, all of them failed. Rudy was a bit depressed, but everything slowly changed when he met someone who was introduced by his friend.

Fun Fact: This VN character design was designed by Artificial Intelligence (AI).
translation:
鲁迪刚从大学毕业，本该顺顺利利地从事自己梦寐以求的工作。然而，他的父母和邻居却开始逼他结婚。无奈之下，鲁迪只好认命，开始通过应用程序寻找女友，可惜都以失败告终。他有些沮丧，不过，在结识朋友介绍的一个人后，一切逐渐发生了变化。

趣闻。本作的角色设计由人工智能（AI）完成。
